summary: the rows of frame_hosttest.c with four faults in private copies of rach2/sys/mm/frame.c and frame.h, each of which must fail the checks named for it, as often as named, and no other; frame.h reaches boot.h by a relative path, so the build copies rach2/sys under the work directory, and the test prints each failed check's line of the test with the count of its failures so far

argv: set -e; rm -rf ${WORK}/b; mkdir -p ${WORK}/b/rach2; cp -R rach2/sys ${WORK}/b/rach2/; cp ${SRC}/rach2/sys/mm/frame.c ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/mm/frame.c; cp ${SRC}/rach2/sys/mm/frame.h ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/mm/frame.h; ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/lib -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/proc -I utils -I krffs -I tests/host/compat -o ${WORK}/frame_hosttest tests/host/frame_hosttest.c ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/mm/frame.c

s=0; ${WORK}/frame_hosttest >${WORK}/frame.out 2>&1 || s=$?; awk 'NR == FNR { src[FNR] = $0; next } /^frame_hosttest: line [0-9]+$/ { t = src[$3]; sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", t); n[t]++; print "frame_hosttest: failed: " t " (" n[t] ")"; next } { print }' tests/host/frame_hosttest.c ${WORK}/frame.out; exit $s

faults.name: acpi-nvs-as-ram
faults.summary: counts every map type but "reserved" as memory, so the NVS and ACPI ranges of the Lenovo's map and of the UEFI map become usable

lines: frame_hosttest: failed: CHECK(m.usable_bytes == low && m.unreachable_bytes == high); (1)
frame_hosttest: failed: CHECK(m.usable_bytes == low + high && m.unreachable_bytes == 0); (1)
frame_hosttest: failed: CHECK(frame_map_managed(&m) == low + high - m.reserved_bytes); (1)

faults.name: reach-32
faults.summary: drops what lies at or above 4 GiB on x86-64 too, where the allocator takes every usable range

lines: frame_hosttest: failed: CHECK(frame_map_managed(&m) == MIB(sizes[i]) - KIB(513) - m.reserved_bytes); (1)
frame_hosttest: failed: CHECK(frame_map_managed(&m) == MIB(sizes[i]) - KIB(513) - m.reserved_bytes); (2)
frame_hosttest: failed: CHECK(m.usable_bytes == low + high && m.unreachable_bytes == 0); (1)
frame_hosttest: failed: CHECK(frame_map_managed(&m) == low + high - m.reserved_bytes); (1)
frame_hosttest: failed: CHECK(frame_map_place(&m, KIB(1024), MIB(32), &at) == 0 && at == 0x100000000ULL); (1)

faults.name: ranges-short
faults.summary: keeps one range fewer than FRAME_MAP_RANGES says, which the bound's row needs every one of

lines: frame_hosttest: failed: CHECK(frame_map_reserve(&m, MIB(1 + 4 * i) + KIB(512), MIB(2 + 4 * i)) == 0); (1)

faults.name: place-low
faults.summary: puts the frame table at the bottom of its range instead of the top

lines: frame_hosttest: failed: CHECK(at == MIB(192) - MIB(1) - KIB(4)); (1)
